name: Alias-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method to eliminate high-frequency artifacts in dynamic scene reconstruction caused by Gaussian scale mismatch and lack of frequency constraints when changing camera focal length or distance. It introduces a maximum sampling frequency formulation, a 4D scale-adaptive filter, and a scale loss.
summary: Alias-free 4D Gaussian Splatting eliminates high-frequency artifacts in dynamic scene reconstruction by introducing a maximum sampling frequency formulation and a 4D scale-adaptive filter to flexibly regulate sampling frequency.
